dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament is moving along quickly. Sixteen powerful competitors will be going head-to-head in the next phase of the competition..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Disclaimer - Clause Two: Confirmation of eligibility indicates that the contestant is aware of the possible negative effects that Wisdom Orb usage may have on the body..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Disclaimer - Clause Seven: All rights of interpretation belong to the organizer and researcher, Mr. Kautilya. If a legal dispute shall arise, please refer to the appropriate channels for official procedures..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I don't think I looked at the detailed content of these rules before...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Haniyyah and Pyro-1, keep it up! You guys got this!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Your combat style is bold and a treat to watch."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I wonder if Haniyyah is accepting apprentices? I want to learn how to beast tame from her and make friends with all sorts of Fungi!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Golden Comet and Silver Companion are so ridiculously strong! I wonder if they're Fungi veterans!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With the two of them here, I would say that this season's champions are already decided!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I hear that Silver Companion has an obsession with Mora. Maybe we should pool some together and ask Silver Companion if they can take it easy and throw the match!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "That way, ordinary people like us would have a shot at winning the competition!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Are you a competitor from their group!? It would be cheating if you tried to use Mora to bribe them!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "They'll let their skills do the talking! You should use the time you spent coming up with stupid ideas like this to train instead!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I think it's still too early to say that they'll be the final winners. I'm pretty sure they'll have a hard time if they're matched against Fried Tofu With All the Frills."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What's going on!? Is there a comment Paimon shouldn't see!?

choices.text: (Pretend not to have seen it and cover Paimon's eyes.)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "A foreign guest by the name of Aratani is collecting photos of the Fungi. They say that she has ways to produce Fungi picture cards that are extremely valuable collectibles!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "But Miss Aratani seems to be looking to make money off this. That's why she's dividing up the sales channel for the picture cards."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Anyone who's willing to purchase her cards, please leave a comment below! If you have any cute photos of the Fungi, make sure you send them to us as well!"
